# Best MagSafe Car Charger Mounts

## Top picks

**1. Best for most people: Belkin BoostCharge Magnetic Wireless Charging Car Vent Mount (Qi2 15W), about $47.99**
- Qi2 15W charging, and it rotates between portrait and landscape.
- The 27W car adapter and USB-C cable are included.
- Fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Your vent slats should be no thicker than 3 mm and no deeper than 20 mm. Horizontal slats work best. Vertical ones can droop.
- Sources: [rottenwifi.com](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [cloudspress.com](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**2. Best for charging speed: Anker Prime Wireless Car Charger, MagGo AirCool (A2933), $69.99–$89.99**
- Qi2 25W charging with a thermoelectric cooler and fan, so it stays fast while running navigation in the sun.
- It needs a 45W or higher USB-C adapter. Reviewers say Anker includes a 60W one, but confirm that on the listing.
- Speed depends on your phone: up to 25W on iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max, 22W on 16/16 Pro, and about 15W on iPhone 15 and older. It is not compatible with the iPhone 16e.
- The vent clamp fits 10–24 mm vents. It doesn't work with Tesla or Mercedes vents.
- Sources: [mountguys.com](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**3. Best value with cooling: ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost**
- Qi2 15W charging (WPC-certified) with a built-in fan.
- Mounts on a vent clip or with dashboard adhesive.
- A car adapter is likely not included.
- Price varies a lot by store:
  - $39.99 at ESR's own store, or $32.80 with code PARTNER18. The deal site that lists the code ([dealectric.com](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)) earns a commission if you buy through it.
  - The Gadgeteer saw it at $18.99 on Amazon in June ([the-gadgeteer.com](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)).
- Check Amazon before buying from ESR's store.

## Other good options (from [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with Cooling Fan, about $39.95:** cheapest 25W option with a fan, and a 95W adapter is included. The suction base is bulky.
- **iOttie Velox Mini Qi2, about $41:** dash or windshield mount, charger included.
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2, about $59.99:** premium build with NFC Shortcuts. No fan, so it may slow down in heat.

## Quick buying tips
- **Look for a Qi2 badge.** Mounts labeled only "MagSafe-compatible" often charge iPhones at just 7.5W.
- **Get the right adapter.** Plan on 30–45W+ for 25W mounts. Your car's built-in USB port probably isn't enough.
- **Check your vents** before choosing a vent clip. If they're thin or vertical, pick a dash mount.

**My suggestion:** For an iPhone 16 or 17, get the Anker Prime if you want the fastest and most reliable option, or the LISEN Qi2.2 to save money. For an iPhone 15 or older, the Belkin or ESR is plenty, since your phone tops out at 15W anyway.

Note: Apart from the ESR deal page, the search results didn't include direct store links. The reviews above say every pick is sold on Amazon, so search the product names there.
